description_en: Searches for code repository data based on query conditions
description_zh: 根据查询条件搜索代码仓库数据
name: ListSearchRepository

parameters.help_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID. It is a string that can be obtained from the Yunxiao access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the creator. Only single-user filtering is supported
parameters.help_zh: 创建人的阿里云账号ID，仅支持单人筛选
parameters.name: aliyun_pk

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Default value: default. Valid values:
default: Default sort order, which is comprehensive sorting.
created_at: Creation time.
updated_at: Update time.
star: Number of favorites.
like: Number of likes.
comment: Number of comments.
reply: Number of replies
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为default
default：默认排序，即综合排序
created_at：创建时间
updated_at：更新时间
star：收藏数
like：点赞数
comment：评论数
reply：回复数
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. The pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The match type of the query. Valid values:
term: Exact match.
regex: Regular expression match.
phrase: Phrase match. This is the default match type.
wildcard: Fuzzy match
fields.help_zh:
查询匹配类型
term：精确匹配
regex：正则匹配
phrase：短语匹配，默认方式
wildcard：模糊匹配
fields.name: match_type

fields.help_en:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:
equal: Equal to.
unequal: Not equal to.
and: AND.
or: OR.
not: NOT
fields.help_zh:
查询条件类型
equal：等于
unequal：不等于
and：与
or：或
not：非
fields.name: operator_type

fields.help_en: The full path of the code repository, such as organization/group/repo. If multiple full paths are specified, separate them with commas (,)
fields.help_zh:
代码库的全路径，例如：organization/group/repo
若有多个代码库全路径，使用英文逗号","隔开
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The query conditions for the code repository
parameters.name: repo_path

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. Default value: all. Valid values:
all: Global scope, including public repositories and private repositories that you have permissions to access.
mine: Repositories where you are a repository or group member and have read permissions
parameters.help_zh:
搜索范围，默认为all
all：全局范围，公开库以及有权限的private库
mine：只作为库或组成员，并且有读权限
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:
desc: Descending order.
asc: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认为desc
desc：降序
asc：升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the code repository. Valid values:
0: Private.
10: Visible to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
代码库的可见性
0：私有
10：企业可见
parameters.name: visibility_level

creatorUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator, which is the Yunxiao ID of the user
creatorUserId.description_zh: 创建人的userId，此处为用户的云效ID

description.description_en: The description of the code repository

readMe.description_en: The highlighted information of the README file
readMe.example:
# Demo
这是一个演示代码库。

repoNameWithNamespace.description_en: The full name of the code repository, including the full group name
repoNameWithNamespace.description_zh: 代码库完整名称（带完整组名称）

repoPath.description_en: The full path of the code repository, including the full group path
repoPath.description_zh: 代码库完整路径（含完整组路径）

source.description_en: The source information returned by Elasticsearch

description.description_en: The description of the code repository

lastActivityTime.description_en: The time of the last activity

organizationId.description_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID. It is a string that can be obtained from the Yunxiao access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
organizationId.description_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

readMe.description_en: The content of the README file
readMe.example:
# Demo
这是一个演示代码库。

repoName.description_en: The name of the code repository

repoPath.description_en: The full path of the code repository, including the full group path
repoPath.description_zh: 代码库完整路径（含完整组路径）

visibilityLevel.description_en:
The visibility. Valid values:
0: Private. Visible only to members of the code repository.
10: Public within the enterprise. Visible to members of the enterprise
visibilityLevel.description_zh:
可见性
0：私有，仅代码库成员可见
10：企业内公开，企业成员可见

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
